name: hex
description: Hex (hex.pm), the package registry for the Erlang/Elixir/Gleam ecosystem. The CLI searches packages, reads package, release, owner and user metadata from the public JSON API, lists dependents, reads raw release files and shows per-user download stats.

commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Search Hex packages by keyword, with optional qualifiers (depends:hexpm:<pkg>, build_tool:<tool>), sorting and pagination.

params.name: search
params.description: Search query. Plain keywords match name and description. Qualifiers can be combined with keywords, e.g. 'json build_tool:rebar3' or 'depends:hexpm:jason'.

commands.name: list-package-dependents
commands.summary: List packages on the hexpm repository that depend on a given package.

params.name: name
params.description: Package name whose dependents to list

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get package details: description, licenses, links, owners, latest versions, download counts, retirements, security advisories and dependency config snippets.
commands.source: E2 E9 E13 E19 GET https://hex.pm/api/packages/jason

commands.name: list-package-versions
commands.summary: List all released versions of a package, newest first, with docs availability and publish date.

commands.name: get-release
commands.summary: Get one release of a package: checksum, dependency requirements, build tools, Elixir requirement, publisher, retirement status, downloads and advisories.

commands.name: list-package-owners
commands.summary: List the owners of a package, with ownership level, email and social handles.

commands.name: get-user
commands.summary: Get a Hex user's public profile and the full list of packages they own.

commands.name: get-user-stats
commands.summary: Show per-package download stats for a user's packages: total, yesterday and last 7 days.

commands.name: get-release-file
commands.summary: Fetch the raw contents of a file inside a package release (e.g. README.md, CHANGELOG.md, mix.exs, lib/...).

params.name: path
params.description: File path inside the release, e.g. README.md, CHANGELOG.md, mix.exs

notes: All data is public. No login is needed.

Search qualifiers go inside --search: 'depends:hexpm:<pkg>' filters to packages that depend on <pkg>, and 'build_tool:<mix|rebar3|make|gleam>' filters by build tool. Both can be combined with keywords.
Release dependencies are in the 'requirements' object of get-release. It is keyed by dependency name, and each entry has 'requirement' and 'optional'.
Security advisories and retirements appear in get-package (security_advisories, retirements) and in get-release (security_advisories, retirement).
get-release-file returns raw text. Use CHANGELOG.md or LICENSE as --path for changelogs and licenses. Not every package ships these files. Nested paths contain '/', e.g. lib/phoenix.ex.
Docs tarballs are binary at https://repo.hex.pm/docs/{name}-{version}.tar.gz. Hosted docs are at the docs_html_url returned by get-package and get-release.

The version diff page (/diff/{name}/{a}..{b}) is disallowed by robots.txt and is not covered. The package audit-log page (/packages/{name}/audit-logs) is not covered either, because its item structure was not visible.
The API search returns up to 100 packages per page. Increment --page until an empty array comes back.
